parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the rocker switch part of the electrical switch assembly, made of ABS plastic. It is the red portion that toggles between ON and OFF positions.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the user interface for controlling the electrical circuit, allowing current to flow or stop when toggled.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots or rocks around a central axis to switch between ON and OFF positions.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the rocker switch, made of polycarbonate. It houses the internal electrical contacts and provides structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the switch mechanism and electrical terminals, ensuring stability and insulation for the electrical connections.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides a fixed housing for the moving switch component.
